_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: a whole cube (n × n × n); 2: a cube cut by a set size, or steps cut from a 3 × 3 × 3 cube; 3: steps on a 4 × 4 × 4 cube, the cubes removed or to be added, or a layer taken off every face; 4: cubes hidden in a corner pile, or the area of the outside. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
